lemmas.name: hoeffding_fixed_t
lemmas.statement: P(|muhat_{i,t} - mu_i| > r(t)) <= 2 exp(-2 t r(t)^2) at FIXED t (valid here: phase count is deterministic per (i,t) pair)

lemmas.name: good_event_union_bound
lemmas.statement: P(E^c) <= K * delta/K = delta — FAILS AUDIT: event E quantifies over every arm AND every completed phase t, union bound counts only the K arms; per-(i,t) failure mass delta/K is constant in t, honest bound scales with number of phases (library's own good event needs L = log(2KT/delta))

lemmas.name: optimal_arm_survives
lemmas.statement:
theorem est_le_est_add_two_radius (a b x y r : ℝ)
    (ha : |a - x| ≤ r) (hb : |b - y| ≤ r) (hxy : x ≤ y) :
    a ≤ b + 2 * r
lemmas.proof:
have h1 := abs_le.mp ha
  have h2 := abs_le.mp hb
  linarith [h1.1, h1.2, h2.1, h2.2]

import Mathlib.Data.Real.Basic

  have h1 := abs_le.mp ha

lemmas.name: elimination_time_threshold
lemmas.statement: t > 4L/Delta^2 => Delta > 4 sqrt(L/(2t)) (Step 4) — REFUTED, correct threshold is 8L/Delta^2

lemmas.name: pull_count_bound
lemmas.statement: N_i(T) <= floor(4L/Delta_i^2)+1 (Step 5) — BLOCKED downstream of elimination_time_threshold

lemmas.name: regret_assembly
lemmas.statement: R_T <= sum_i (Delta_i + 4L/Delta_i) (Step 6) — BLOCKED downstream of pull_count_bound and good_event_union_bound

certificate.check: hypothesis 17 > 4*1/(1/2)^2 = 16 holds; claim needs Delta^2 > 8L/t i.e. 1/4 > 8/17 — false (exact in Q)

verdict_reason: two independent failures: (1) elimination_time_threshold (Step 4) is false — t > 4L/Delta^2 does not imply Delta > 4 r(t); exact counterexample L=1, Delta=1/2, t=17 (correct threshold is 8L/Delta^2, so the theorem's constant 4 ln(2K/delta)/Delta_i should be 8 ln(2K/delta)/Delta_i); (2) good_event_union_bound (Step 1) is invalid — the event quantifies over every completed phase t but the union bound counts only the K arms; the per-(i,t) failure mass delta/K is constant in t, so the honest bound grows with the number of phases and P(E) >= 1-delta does not follow with r(t) free of T
